findingClass: an ipo_field_plan row retired at the attempts cap (FIELD_PLAN_RECLAIM_MAX_ATTEMPTS) by a GAP — configuration (a manifest rank naming a source with no field mapping, a DOC rank with no documentType, a source with no registered fetcher, a DOC column read not implemented) or extractor (no document provenance on a COMPLETED document) — rather than by a real failure (#884: 6,220 staging rows across 72 IPOs on 2026-09-23)
whatItAsks: no CHECK_FAILED plan row at attempts >= the cap has a gap cause: a gap-key-stamped cause ([gap-key:...]) or a legacy free-text gap marker (isConfigGapAtCapRow, the pinned mirror of FIELD_PLAN_CONFIG_GAP_CAUSE_MARKERS / FIELD_PLAN_GAP_KEY_PREFIX)
alarmsWhen: any non-zero, named by IPO slug and table.field
scope: every IPO, every status and segment, prod + staging slots; state = CHECK_FAILED, attempts >= cap
consumerReason: a structural fact about the attempts accounting, read by row identity each run — sibling of pull_plan_stuck_reclaim
note: Companion CI half: scraper/tests/unit/config/manifest-rank-coverage-gaps.test.ts lists every manifest rank the walk cannot ask, read through resolveFieldSourcePolicy per IPO type (311 on 2026-09-23: 201 no-mapping, 96 DOC column read not implemented, 7 DOC no-documentType, 7 no-fetcher) against a shrink-only baseline, so a NEW gap fails CI. Review round 1 widened the class to extractor gaps (MAJOR-2).
